subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The committee __deposed__ him from his office.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Promoted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deposed"** means to remove someone from office or power, often in a formal or forceful manner. (पदच्युत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The king was deposed after a military coup.
 
 
 
• **"Promoted"** refers to advancing someone to a higher position or rank. (पदोन्नत करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She was promoted to the position of manager after years of hard work.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'deposed'** is **'promoted'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Promoted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interacted** (परस्पर संवाद करना): To communicate or engage with someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher interacted with the students to understand their doubts.
 
 
 
• **Demolished** (ध्वस्त करना): To completely destroy a building or other structure.
 
 
• **Example: **The old building was demolished to make way for a new park.
 
 
 
• **Segregated** (अलग करना): To separate or set apart from others or from the main group.
 
 
• **Example:** The school segregated students based on their abilities.
 
 

39:Tb3a,

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To have complete knowledge.</
